name: project-publisher
description: Review, position, publish, promote, and keep a project's public materials current.

interface.shortDescription: Give a project a clear, verifiable public life.
interface.longDescription: Reviews and positions the real project, prepares only the public materials its type needs, coordinates a bundled Humanizer copy pass, checks public risk, creates purposeful proof, prepares releases and distribution, and keeps later updates synchronized while remote actions stay behind explicit authorization.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $project-publisher to review this project before I publish or update it. Start read-only, show me the biggest reason a new visitor may not understand or try it, and recommend the smallest useful fix before any remote action.
